question: How should Gaganā be invoked with the given syllables at the end of the rakṣas group?
premises: The syllables oṃ and auṃ are specified.
The placement is at the end of the rakṣas group.
Gaganā is to be included as before.
inference: One should invoke Gaganā with oṃ and auṃ at the end of the rakṣas group as before.
plain_english: O beloved, use oṃ and auṃ at the end of the rakṣas group with Gaganā, as before.
